# Millionærklubben Eksklusiv: Danmarks største aktietalent  - del 2

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-06  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is part 2 of Millionærklubben's live panel, recorded right after a big Democratic win in the US midterm elections. Lars Svendsen ('Lav') is very bearish. He expects oil prices to peak and possibly oil rationing because of Iran, calls US AI and IT a bubble likely to end in a crash, and says cash is now 20-35% across the portfolios he manages, with a Torm sale under way. Michael Friis-Hørsen says the election changes little politically, warns against overpaying for 'safe' stocks such as Walmart, prefers consumer stocks and Nike as the affordability play, and expects a year-end Santa Claus rally. Most of the panel expects higher index levels by year-end, but the mood is split by deep worries about oil, interest rates, inflation, AI valuations and European election risk.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NKE — Nike | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Consumer discretionary named as the affordability play after the Democratic win. Nike is the one consumer stock that hasn't run up yet; earlier contrarian 'buy it, everyone hates it' call.

#### Reasoning

The panel thinks Democrats will push affordability policies that put more money in consumers' hands. Consumer discretionary stocks have already rallied, but Nike has not. Lars Persson's contrarian call from about 2.5 months ago (hated by everyone, nobody owns it) is repeated by Michael, who adds that money could flow into it if AI cracks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the affordability policy push stalls in a gridlocked Congress
- if consumer spending weakens on an oil shock

> *"Ja, undtaget Nike. Er det to og en halv måned siden, vi har Lars Gård gået ind og sige, jeg kan ikke give dig en grund til at købe den, men køb den. Fordi den er hadet af alle."*

---

### ⛔ WMT — Walmart | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Michael: buying Walmart at a P/E of 30 (re-rated from 20) without earnings growth is a recipe for disaster.

#### Reasoning

Michael argues that money is rotating out of high-growth AI names into 'safe' defensive stocks like Walmart without any matching earnings growth. The valuation multiple has expanded from about 20x to 30x earnings while earnings stay flat, leaving downside risk if the rotation reverses.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Walmart's earnings growth accelerates enough to justify the multiple

> *"Så lige nu betaler vi PEI 30 for Walmart, kørt op for PEI 20 ... Det er recipe for disaster."*

---

### 🔴 TRMD-A — Torm | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lav is selling Torm to raise cash to about 35% because he fears a sharp market fall.

#### Reasoning

Lars Svendsen is selling the Torm holding as part of de-risking: cash is 20-25% at his company and will reach about 35% in the other portfolio once Torm is sold. He expects an oil-price peak and a crash in the US/AI market, and the sale reflects a broad risk-off move rather than a view specific to Torm.

> *"når vi får solgt vores torm, så er selv vores adriportefølge op på 35, 35 procent kasse"*

---

### 🟡 MAERSK-B — A.P. Møller | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lav expects that in a US crash everyone will want his A.P. Møller shares; he won't sell them.

#### Reasoning

Lav thinks money will flow from the US into small European markets after a US/AI crash, because government bonds are no longer a safe haven. He treats A.P. Møller shares as a sought-after quality holding he will not give up.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the expected flow of money into European stocks does not happen

> *"Så alle kommer og spørger, om ikke de kan købe vores ABMøller-aktier. That'll be the day."*

---

### ⛔ MSFT — Microsoft | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Lav: in the AI boom the suppliers make money while Microsoft and Apple end up losing it.

#### Reasoning

Lav sees AI as an investment boom where suppliers like Nvidia capture the profits and the big spenders such as Microsoft and Apple lose money. He also expects a large Nasdaq 100 crash. The view is broad and speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI spending turns into clear revenue growth

> *"Og så bliver det Microsoft og Apple og de andre, som kommer til at tabe pengene."*

---

### ⛔ AAPL — Apple | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Lav: Apple, along with Microsoft, will end up losing money on the AI investment boom.

#### Reasoning

Same AI-bubble view from Lav: the spending companies lose, the suppliers win, and he expects a broad Nasdaq crash. Speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI spending turns into clear revenue growth

> *"Og så bliver det Microsoft og Apple og de andre, som kommer til at tabe pengene."*
